# Supabase RLS Exposure Checker

> Free, in-browser tool: paste your Supabase project URL and anon key, and it sends a real read-only request to every table it can see, naming which ones return real rows to an unauthenticated request -- the CVE-2025-48757 missing-RLS exposure class. Nothing uploaded to us.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
